message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a tire carousel storage rack. Likely classification is heading 8428 (other lifting, handling, loading or unloading machinery). A carousel with motor-driven chains for storing and retrieving tires is similar to a vertical carousel storage system, which falls under 8428.90. The subheading 8428.90.02 covers "other machinery," and the statistical suffixes below it are 8428.90.0290 (other) and others.

The 8428.90 breakdown is: 8428.90.01 (Other machinery: Self-propelled), 8428.90.02 (Other machinery: Other: Of a kind used for...?), 8428.90.03 (Other: Other), and so on. I believe the 2020s structure is 8428.90.0290 and 8428.90.0390? I recall 8428.90.0290 being "Other machinery... Other: Other". I believe in the rulings for carousel systems, the code used was 8428.90.0290 (Other lifting, handling, loading or unloading machinery: Other: Other).

I'll go with 8428.90.0290.
